calls.thesis: Guest Whitney Tilson (Stansberry): Casey's General Stores down 34% in 2 months to 26x forward earnings (was 35x); pullback from guidance miss not thesis-breaking; 3,000 Midwestern c-stores, huge expansion runway, Walmart-in-1988 analogue.
calls.bull_case: Double-digit earnings growth for 10+ years makes 26x a bargain; could nearly double footprint on Texas small towns alone.
calls.bear_case: Premium multiple still needs flawless execution; higher fuel prices squeeze inside-store (high-margin) spend.
